annotations.title: Get Dilution Instrument Rows by Family

description: One instrument family's rows with per-field SEC citations (accession number, filing date and the verbatim sentence each figure was read from). Families: warrants, convertibles, preferred, shelfs, atms, elocs, s1_offerings, equity_plans, exchangeables, recent_offerings, rights; each call returns one family. `withheldRows` / `withheldRowCount`: rows that could not be verified were blanked, so every family total is a lower bound. An empty rows array on a covered company is a measured "none found in the filings read"; an unavailable response is not. `disputed` status (warrants / convertibles / preferred / exchangeables): the issuer's latest filing disputes the instrument; it is shown and excluded from totals (`summary.disputedInstrumentCount` / `disputedInstrumentShares`), and it is a disputed claim, neither outstanding nor retired. `contingencyTrigger: "event_of_default"`: the instrument is still outstanding and counted; it converts only on an event of default, which does not make it non-dilutive. Convertibles with `principalBasis` `aggregate_only` / `fair_value_only` / `conflict` / `undisclosed_since_issue`: the current balance is not measured (`principalOutstanding` null), and `principalOriginal` is the original principal, not the current balance. `conversionBasis: "formula_unanchored"`: no share count is computable, so the share count is unquantified, not zero. Convertibles / preferred `sharesIssuableBasis: "conflict_upper_bound"`: `sharesIssuableIfConverted` is an upper bound (up to that many shares) and `sharesIssuableIssuerStated` is the issuer's own count; the higher figure is not the issuer's count. Warrants with null `sharesUnderlying` beside `aggregateExerciseValueDollars` / `exercisePriceFloor` / `sharesCeilingAsFiled` are dollar-denominated or capped: `summary.warrantSharesCeiling` is a ceiling, not a count, and is not in `potentialNewShares`. `warrantCount` counts warrants, not shares. Shelfs: `babyShelfCurrentCapacityDollars` is a stored, dated figure, not today's headroom: it is as of `babyShelfCapacityAsOf` (null = undated, not current), `babyShelfCapacityBasis` names its float, and it is not the live raisable-now computation. Rights (SPAC unit rights): `rightsCount` counts rights, not shares; `sharesPerRight` is the printed fraction of a share per right; `sharesUnderlying` is the share count (null = unsized, not 0), delivered on the initial business combination and lapsing if none closes. A snapshot stored before this family existed returns `examined: false` for rights, meaning not analysed, not "no rights". Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
